wave: WP-I W1 (rust2/wire-w1): factor, shuf, ptx, csplit, pathchk, arch, groups, pinky, who
english_catalog: 3644 messages (extract after the W1 wiring; 3619 before)
notes: Applies on top of unixwin/winuxcmd-i18n catalogs/zh-CN/catalog.json (VERSION 0.6.35).
catalogs/ changes require bumping VERSION in the same PR (at least the patch segment): 0.6.35 -> 0.6.36.

Every `set` key is new or re-worded with NAMED placeholders; the old catalog entries for the four re-worded keys used GNU {} positionals and included the program prefix, so they must be replaced, not merged.

The `remove` keys are legacy.<fnv> reverse-lookup entries whose producing C++ bodies were deleted by this wave; the rust2 bodies emit the stable command.<cmd>.error.* keys instead. The bridge drains rust2 output through the RAW writers, so no legacy lookup is involved any more.
Program prefixes (factor:, csplit:, shuf:, ...) stay in code per the I18N discipline; translations carry the inner error() wording only.
